data.title: Iran, Iraq and Gulf States to Hold Regional Meeting in Oman on September 14
data.description: Iran, Iraq and other Gulf coastal states will hold a regional meeting in Oman on September 14, according to Jiemian News. Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei said the talks will cover regional issues and the results of negotiations between Iran and Oman on the security of maritime passage through the Strait of Hormuz. Baghaei said Iran seeks to ensure shipping safety in the strait, but added that safety cannot be guaranteed as long as what he described as U.S. maritime blockade, economic warfare and illegal interference continue.

data.title: STOCKS | Ford Recalls 223,472 Vehicles in the U.S. Over Fuel Tank Issue
data.description: U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration said Ford Motor is recalling 223,472 vehicles in the United States because fuel tanks may leak and be improperly secured, allowing them to detach while driving. According to Sina Finance, the recall covers some 2023 to 2027 Ford F-150 models, and dealers will inspect and replace the tank retaining straps free of charge if needed.

data.title: Whale Sells 9,976.46 ETH Long Positions and Reopens ETH Buy Orders
data.description: A highly profitable whale reduced 9,976.46 ETH long positions in batches about 11 hours ago at an average price of about $2,619.87, with a notional value of about $26.137 million and a profit of about $14.22 million. According to Odaily, the whale later placed ETH buy orders again.

data.title: U.S. Defense Secretary Hegseth Says Iran Will Never Have Nuclear Weapons
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, U.S. Defense Secretary Hegseth said at a September 11 event marking the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks that the United States had gone through its darkest period and is now stronger than ever, adding that the U.S. had dealt a heavy blow to Iran over the past six months and would ensure Iran "never has nuclear weapons."

data.title: BRICS Leaders Gather In New Delhi Amid Iran-UAE Rift Over Persian Gulf Crisis
data.description: According to Nikkei Asia, top leaders of BRICS countries have gathered in New Delhi for a two-day summit and face pressure to issue a joint statement as Iran and the United Arab Emirates remain at loggerheads over the widening Persian Gulf crisis.

data.title: Akazawa Says U.S.-Japan Tariff Deal Projects May Focus on Power Industry
data.description: According to Nikkei Asia, Japanese Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry Ryosei Akazawa said new investment projects under the U.S.-Japan tariff agreement are likely to center on the power industry, with next-generation nuclear initiatives potentially back on the table.

data.title: Robinhood Chain Revenue Falls 85% From September 4 Peak, DeFiLlama Data Shows
data.description:
DeFiLlama data shows Robinhood Chain revenue has continued to decline since reaching about $5.44 million on September 4. According to Odaily, revenue fell to $841,178 on September 11, marking three straight days below $1 million and an 85% drop from the peak.

The data also showed Robinhood Chain's 24-hour DEX trading volume at about $2.498 billion. Revenue over the past seven days was $10.55 million, while revenue over the past 30 days was about $32.29 million.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Xi Jinping Arrives in Delhi for BRICS Summit 2026
data.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Delhi for the BRICS Summit 2026 ahead of bilateral talks, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Iran Says U.S. Aggression Continues to Threaten Strait of Hormuz Shipping Security
data.description: According to Jin10, Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei said on September 11 that Iran, Iraq, and other Gulf states will hold a regional meeting in Oman on the 14th and discuss the results of Iran-Oman talks on a safe maritime passage in the Strait of Hormuz.

data.title: China Overseas Wins Shenzhen Core District Residential Plot for 2.55 Billion Yuan
data.description:
China Overseas Land & Investment won a 5,844.41-square-meter residential plot in Shenzhen's Futian district for 2.55 billion yuan on September 10, after 250 rounds of offline bidding, according to Jiemian News. The deal implies a floor price of 98,069 yuan per square meter and a premium of 125.46%; excluding supporting construction, the effective residential floor price is about 103,147 yuan per square meter.

The B401-0151 site, at the northwest corner of the intersection of Antuoshan Fourth Road and Qiaoxiang Third Road in the Xiangmihu area, has planned gross floor area of 26,002 square meters, a plot ratio of about 3.1 and a height limit of 100 meters. It was offered with a starting price of 1.131 billion yuan and no ceiling on the land price. The plot was originally commercial land and was later rezoned for residential use. Under the plan, it includes 24,722 square meters of housing, 1,000 square meters of transferable commercial space, 100 square meters for property services and 180 square meters for a telecom equipment room. The project requires delivery with title registration upon handover, construction to start within one year and completion within four years.

Seven developers, including China Overseas, China Resources Land, China Merchants Shekou, C&D, a Yuexiu-Deep Industry consortium, China Railway and Shenzhen Zhenye, took part in the bidding. The site is the first core-area residential land sold in Shenzhen after the city's August 28 housing policy easing, and the first pure commodity housing plot in Xiangmihu since 2017. Jiemian News reported that the strong bidding reflected demand for scarce core land in the Xiangmihu-Antuoshan area, which has limited new housing supply and no mandatory affordable-housing or talent-housing allocation.

The article also said China Overseas reported contracted property sales of 134.35 billion yuan in the first half of 2026, up 11.8% year on year, while new land purchases totaled 9 plots with attributable land cost of about 7.66 billion yuan. By the end of June, its land bank excluding China Overseas Grand Oceans had a total gross floor area of 22.07 million square meters, with attributable gross floor area of 19.6 million square meters, and about 86.5% in first-tier and strong second-tier cities. In August, Chairman Yan Jianguo said the company kept its full-year target for attributable new land investment at 80 billion to 100 billion yuan.

data.title: India's SEBI Seeks Public Input on Closing Auction, Derivatives Settlement Changes
data.description: India's Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) on September 12 issued a consultation paper seeking public comments on changes to the closing auction session (CAS), derivatives contract settlement methods and market trading hours, according to Jiemian News. SEBI said it is studying two ways to calculate derivatives expiry settlement prices and may adopt a hybrid VWAP method that combines continuous trading and closing auction trades. It also proposed two trading-hour options: under Option A, continuous trading for CAS stocks would run until 3:30 pm, followed by the closing auction, while derivatives trading would be extended to 3:45 pm; under Option B, continuous trading for CAS stocks would end at 3:15 pm, CAS would run from 3:15 pm to 3:25 pm, and derivatives trading would end at 3:30 pm. SEBI also proposed banning limit orders that deviate by more than 1% from the reference price from being canceled during the closing auction, while still allowing price improvements and the remaining quantity of unfilled iceberg orders to enter CAS. The regulator said the proposal follows market feedback after CAS was implemented on August 3, 2026, and aims to improve the link between cash and derivatives markets and the closing price discovery mechanism. Public comments are due by October 3.

data.title: Polymarket Fulham FC Second-Half Over 1.5 Odds Jump to 31%
data.description: Catcher Predict monitoring showed sharp volatility in the Polymarket submarket "Fulham FC Second-Half O/U 1.5" under the "Liverpool FC vs. Fulham FC - More Markets" event, with the "Over" option rising from 11% one hour earlier to 31% at present. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflected a 20% swing and may have been affected by breaking news.

data.title: Iranian President Pezeshkian Meets Ethiopian Prime Minister at BRICS Summit
data.description: According to Jin10, Iranian President Pezeshkian met with Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed during the BRICS summit.

data.title: Iran Civil Aviation Spokesperson Denies Rumors of Turkish Airport Service Suspension
data.description: According to Jin10, the spokesperson for Iran's Civil Aviation Organization denied rumors that Turkey had stopped providing airport services and ground handling for Iranian airlines, and said Iranian airlines' flight operations were continuing as scheduled.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Xi to Take Spotlight at Modi’s BRICS Summit as Iran War Deepens
data.description:
Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to open a BRICS summit in New Delhi that will try to find common ground as the war in the Middle East escalates, according to Bloomberg.

The gathering comes as the conflict threatens to widen divisions among the bloc’s members.

data.title: Iranian President: Relations With Neighboring Countries Are a Main Strategy
data.description: According to Jin10, Iranian President Pezeshkian said that developing relations with neighboring and brotherly countries is one of the main strategies of the Islamic Republic of Iran.

data.title: SemiAnalysis Acquires Citrini Research, Bloomberg Reports
data.description: SemiAnalysis has acquired independent investment research firm Citrini Research, according to Bloomberg. According to PANews, Citrini Research founder James van Geelen will remain chief executive for now, and the firm will retain some operational independence rather than being fully folded into the SemiAnalysis brand. The transaction price was not disclosed.

data.title: Summit Place Financial Advisors Founder Says Fed Rate Hike Is Fundamentally Unnecessary
data.description: According to Jin10, Liz Miller, founder and president of U.S. wealth management firm Summit Place Financial Advisors, said further tightening is fundamentally unnecessary despite broad market expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise rates next week, citing overall economic stability.

data.title: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung Says Middle East Oil Dependence Has Fallen to About 50%
data.description: According to Jin10, South Korean President Lee Jae-myung said the country's dependence on Middle East crude oil has fallen from as high as 70% to about 50% in a few months, and that citizens do not need to worry about oil prices.

data.title: Revolut Users’ Personal Data Reportedly Exposed After Fraudulent Request Was Not Identified
data.description:
ZachXBT said Revolut may have failed to identify a fraudulent request, leading to the exposure of some users’ personal identity information. According to Odaily, the leaked data included passport or driver’s license copies and verification selfies, account statements, IBANs, withdrawal records, full transaction histories including Bitcoin transactions, and names, dates of birth, occupations, home addresses, email addresses, and phone numbers.

ZachXBT said the incident may have affected a limited number of users and appeared to target high-net-worth customers. Several Revolut users reportedly received security alert emails yesterday.
